messages:
Rachel T: Heads-up: after the routing change this morning we started seeing intermittent SSE stalls that look like resume vs keepalive races. UI shows spinner -> then stream resumes with no reconnect. Anyone else?
Omar K: saw it on canary eu-north. Console session count steady but last-output time jumps. Customer flagged it in support.
Jin W: paste sanitized client trace? need to know if client got any keepalive frames or just silent TCP.
Rachel T: trace (sanitized):
```
GET /v1/stream?model=redwood-fast
: 200 OK
data: {"delta":"chunk1"}
... <9s silence> ...
data: {"delta":"chunk2"}
```
Omar K: 9s aligns with our edge probe TTL. We merged probe-suppression to cut tiny-eip costs during route handover. Maybe probes suppressed during sticky-handoff.
Jin W: But sticky-handoff shouldn't drop pings. It just pins session to old worker while new route syncs. If old worker pauses probe emission during handoff window we get exactly this.
Rachel T: UX problem: console shows only OPEN sockets. PMs can't tell whether session is "stalled" vs legitimately idle. We need a "last activity" column (last SSE/ping/frame) and a "silent stall rate" time series.
Omar K: +1. Also for debugging we need sampled raw byte timings stored for 0.1% of sessions. Without that we can't distinguish chunking, batching, or probe suppression.
Jin W: infra: can we emit an app-level heartbeat event to control-plane on chunk delivery? That would let console surface last-output even if TCP stays alive.
ops-bot: infra ticket created by Jin W: emit-app-heartbeat -> canary eu-north. CI smoke queued. :white_check_mark:
telemetry-bot: quick query: fast_reconnect_rate(region=eu-north, last_1h) -> 0.03% ; silent_pause_rate(region=eu-north, last_1h) -> 0.8%
Rachel T: Interesting — reconnect rate low but silent_pause high. So clients aren't reconnecting (good) but UX suffers.
Omar K: Billing question: are we double-billing during sticky handoff? token events only when server emits tokens, so likely not. But SDK retries triggered by perceived stall could duplicate work.
Jin W: short-term mitigation: push SDK change to debounce reconnect <250ms if header x-graceful-restart=1 is present. Also add server header x-last-output-ms so clients can suppress spurious retries.
Rachel T: That helps customers. Long term: revert probe-suppression flag on canary until we add the console last-activity tile and heartbeat telemetry.
ops-bot: Deploy job requested by Rachel T: rollback/probe-suppression -> canary eu-north. Smoke tests queued. :white_check_mark:
Omar K: Also want a throttler "soft-deprioritized" counter exposed. We've seen throughput dips where requests still accepted but deprioritized; no 429, so no alert. That can cause perceived stalls.
Jin W: We'll add a metric soft_throttle_count with route labels and surface an alert if soft_throttle_rate > 0.5% for 5m. Also sampling of raw SSE timings for 0.1% of sessions.
Rachel T: Great. Console follow-ups: 1) last-activity column, 2) example traces attached to tile (sampled) 3) note on rollout UX docs explaining drain semantics and recommended SDK debounce.
Omar K: I'll notify support and link the canary rollback. If customers report duplicate jobs, ping me.
Jin W: I'll ship the telemetry PR and coordinate SDK header with devex.
Rachel T: Thanks all, will monitor post-rollback and post-sampling. Report back in 30m. :thumbsup:
